title: The Hidden $250K Bill Inside Every Divorce
hook: Half of marriages end in divorce — and the average couple destroys $250,000 in wealth nobody warned them about.
angle: Not just legal fees — the QDRO taxes, dual-household costs, and compounding wealth gap that permanently alter retirement trajectories
audience: Anyone married, getting married, or thinking about marriage who has never calculated the full financial cost of divorce
key_numbers: Up to 40% of 401k lost to QDRO taxes and penalties
80% higher solo living costs per person
$250,000 average wealth gap at retirement vs. married peers
